author: Diavolo14
quote: As a long-time gamer, I’m very disappointed. they are forcing the player to play with an unlikable character LUCIA doing unlikable chores. It’s not GTA anymore. UNFORTUNATELY, after only a couple days playing it, I have initiated return processes on the PlayStation five. I am not giving my money to a faulty product that failed to communicate with their marketing material pre-release about how the game works and operates. It was misleading and a lie… It’s a scam.
